description: Praxis's LLM client (`praxis/llm.py`) is BYO-key with an OPTIONAL agora path: when `AGORA_BASE_URL` is set every call routes through agora's provider-router instead of the provider's own endpoint (`LLMConfig.routed_via_agora` / `.endpoint` / `.wire_format`), and unset means go direct. This tasklist deepens that opt-in — richer provider-router use behind `AGORA_BASE_URL` (e.g. surfacing router-reported model/route info, honoring router selection/fallback, cleaner error surfacing from the router) — **without ever becoming a hard dependency**: with `AGORA_BASE_URL` unset the direct BYO-key path is byte-for-byte what ships, and no import or call assumes agora is reachable. Because it stays optional, this has NO hard `dependsOn` on agora; it consumes agora's contract by reference (koine specifies, agora implements) rather than re-specifying it. Scope: `praxis/llm.py` (config + call path), the construct/checks callers only where they surface a route, and `tests/` (agora on vs off, both pinned with a stub — no live agora).
warmup: echo 'agora is opt-in behind AGORA_BASE_URL and must NEVER become a hard dependency: unset -> direct BYO-key path unchanged. Consume the contract by reference, do not re-specify it — see praxis/llm.py header and ../CLAUDE.md.'

userStories.title: Richer provider-router use behind AGORA_BASE_URL
acceptanceCriteria: With `AGORA_BASE_URL` set, `praxis/llm.py` uses agora's provider-router more richly than a plain base-URL swap — e.g. it honors the router's selected model/route in what it records and surfaces the router's own error body (the way the client already prefers the provider's message) — extending `LLMConfig`/the call path, not adding a second client.

The agora path stays authenticated per the client's existing rule (`AGORA_API_KEY`, falling back to the provider key) and sends no sampling params the models reject; `describe()` reflects the deeper routing so a human can see the route in use.

Gate green: `python3 -m pytest -q tests/` passes, with a test that drives the agora-routed path against a stub endpoint (no live agora) asserting the request goes to the router and the router's response/errors are surfaced.

userStories.title: Opt-in only — unset AGORA_BASE_URL is the shipped direct path, untouched
acceptanceCriteria: With `AGORA_BASE_URL` unset, the direct BYO-key path is unchanged from what ships — same endpoint resolution, wire format and auth per provider — and no module imports or call assumes agora is present or reachable; agora is never a hard dependency of any code path.

A test pins both modes from the same config resolution (agora on vs off) using an injected env/stub, so the direct path is proven untouched by the deeper integration, and no `dependsOn` on agora is introduced (the contract is consumed by reference).
Gate green: `python3 -m pytest -q tests/` passes; `npm run build` in ui/ and `cargo build` in src-tauri/ pass if either is touched, otherwise unaffected.
